mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is positive over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances following RSAFS growth, or RSAFS growth does not lead to statistically significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is positive over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances following INDPRO decline, or INDPRO decline does not lead to statistically significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 10% YoY and RSAFS increase
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals a tightening labor market and wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (F-test p > 0.05).
